# property of the body, so these rows stay correct under either resolution; only the
# header line naming +0x08 and +0x10 would change.
# Generated 2026-09-22 (OPUS) from the shipping image: records at 0x01EED720, stride
# 0x20, count 0x5D8 = 1,496 from the word at 0x01EED700. Sentinels (0xFFFFFFFF) and
# nulls are omitted. The taxonomy is the one scriptvm-verb-shapes.tsv uses, and the
# control is that re-classifying slot +0x00 reproduces that table's family counts.
